nb31abeaa5c.headline: Azerbaijan's external debt has reached 20.4 percent of GDP
nb31abeaa5c.summary: By mid-2017, Azerbaijan had signed loans totaling $11.2 billion with international financial and credit organizations, pushing external debt to 20.4% of GDP.
nb31abeaa5c.why: External debt levels impact a country's creditworthiness and economic stability, influencing investor confidence and sovereign risk assessments.
